title: Make small talk with colleagues (B1)
summary: Mở và giữ một đoạn trò chuyện xã giao ngắn: hỏi thăm, kể một chuyện nhỏ, hỏi lại và kết thúc tự nhiên.
learningObjectives: Mở đầu trò chuyện bằng câu hỏi thân thiện
Kể một chuyện nhỏ và hỏi lại người kia
Kết thúc trò chuyện tự nhiên

sections.title: Coffee machine chat
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: near the coffee machine on Monday morning. Colleague: Hi, how was your weekend? Notes: answer in two or three sentences, add one detail, ask a question back, react to the answer and end politely.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Thời gian nghỉ cuối tuần, chủ đề trò chuyện quen thuộc.
Trò chuyện để biết chuyện gần đây của nhau.
vocabulary.example: It was good to catch up with you.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Động từ viết catch up, danh từ viết catch-up.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Phản ứng với điều người khác vừa kể.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói "sounds like" + danh từ hoặc mệnh đề; trước tính từ có thể bỏ like: "That sounds fun."

vocabulary.example: By the way, did you see the new menu?
vocabulary.commonMistake: Đặt "by the way" ở đầu câu rồi thêm dấu phẩy; tránh dùng trong văn bản trang trọng.

vocabulary.definition: tôi nên quay lại làm việc
vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Cách lịch sự để kết thúc trò chuyện.
collocations: I should get back to work
vocabulary.example: I should get back to my desk.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói get back to + nơi hoặc việc.

expressions.phrase: It was great, thanks. I ___. How about you?
expressions.meaning: Trả lời ngắn rồi hỏi lại.
expressions.example: It was great, thanks. I went hiking with friends. How about you?
That sounds like fun! Where did you go?

expressions.phrase: It was good to catch up. I should get back to ___.
expressions.example: It was good to catch up. I should get back to my tasks.
alternatives: Anyway, I will let you get back to ___.

exercises.question: Câu trả lời nào giúp cuộc trò chuyện tiếp tục?
options: It was good. I went hiking. How about you?
Fine, thanks. Nothing much to say.
I do not want to talk about it.
correctAnswer: It was good. I went hiking. How about you?
exercises.explanation: Trả lời kèm một chi tiết và hỏi lại.

exercises.question: Câu nào kết thúc cuộc trò chuyện lịch sự?
options: It was good to catch up. I should get back to work.
Stop talking, please, I am too busy to chat with anyone.
I am leaving now, bye then.
correctAnswer: It was good to catch up. I should get back to work.
exercises.explanation: Kết thúc nhẹ nhàng và có lý do.

exercises.question: Điền từ: That sounds ___ a fun weekend!
Sắp xếp cuộc trò chuyện.
exercises.explanation: Trả lời, hỏi lại, phản ứng, kết thúc.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
correctAnswer: catch up - hỏi thăm, cập nhật chuyện
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu (cuối tuần): I had a relaxing ___.
Điền từ còn thiếu (hỏi thăm, cập nhật chuyện): It was good to ___ with you.
exercises.explanation: "catch up" nghĩa là hỏi thăm, cập nhật chuyện.

performanceTask.title: Keep a short small talk going
performanceTask.scenario: Sáng thứ Hai ở máy pha cà phê, đồng nghiệp hỏi cuối tuần của bạn; bạn trò chuyện ngắn rồi quay lại làm việc.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Nói bằng tiếng Anh trong khoảng 45 đến 60 giây: trả lời bằng một chi tiết, hỏi lại đồng nghiệp, phản ứng và kết thúc lịch sự. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about 45 to 60 seconds: answer with one detail, ask your colleague a question, react to the answer and end the chat politely.
performanceTask.modelResponse: It was great, thanks. I went hiking with some friends on Saturday, and the weather was perfect. On Sunday, I just rested and cooked a big lunch. How about you? Oh, that sounds like fun! Two hours is quite a long drive. Did you stay overnight? By the way, did you try the new coffee flavor in the kitchen? I heard it is quite good. Anyway, it was good to catch up. I should get back to my tasks, but let us have lunch together this week.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Speak again in English. Keep the same order and ask a more interesting question.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Make small talk in a different moment, such as in the lunch queue with a new colleague.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Make small talk with a new colleague without looking at old notes.

baseline.title: Weekend chat at the coffee machine
baseline.brief: Sáng thứ Hai, đồng nghiệp hỏi cuối tuần của bạn.

artifacts.title: Weekend chat at the coffee machine
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: near the coffee machine on Monday morning. Colleague: Hi, how was your weekend? Your weekend: you went hiking with some friends on Saturday and the weather was perfect; on Sunday you rested and cooked a big lunch. After you ask back, the colleague says: I went to a lake with my family. It took two hours to drive there. There is a new coffee flavor in the kitchen, and you heard it is quite good.

retry.title: Chat before a meeting
retry.brief: Sửa bài với cuộc trò chuyện trước một buổi họp.

artifacts.title: Chat before a meeting
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: a video call that has not started. Colleague: Hi! Are you ready for the meeting? Everyone else is late. After your reply, the colleague says: I was busy preparing slides all morning.

transfer.title: Chat in the lunch queue
transfer.brief: Tình huống mới: xếp hàng ăn trưa với đồng nghiệp mới.

artifacts.title: Chat in the lunch queue
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: lunch queue. New colleague: This place is busy today. Have you eaten here before? After your reply, the colleague says: I joined last week, so I am still learning where everything is.

review.title: Chat after a team event
review.brief: Ôn lại với buổi trò chuyện sau sự kiện của đội.

artifacts.title: Chat after a team event
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Setting: after the quarterly team event. Colleague: That was a nice evening. Did you enjoy the activity? After your reply, the colleague says: I loved the cooking game. My team won by two points.

rubric.label: Natural flow
rubric.description: The chat has an answer, a question back, a reaction and an ending.

anchors.met: All four moves appear in a natural order.
anchors.notMet: Answers briefly and stops, or ends abruptly.

rubric.label: Asks and reacts
rubric.description: Shows interest in the other person.

anchors.met: Asks a follow-up question and reacts to the reply.

rubric.label: Friendly tone
rubric.description: The tone is warm and relaxed.

anchors.met: Uses friendly phrases such as "That sounds like fun".
anchors.notMet: Sounds flat or formal like a report.

audio.text: Hi, how was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
It was great, thanks. I went hiking with some friends.
That sounds like fun! Where did you go?
It was good to catch up. I should get back to my tasks.
Pretty good, thanks. I mostly rested at home. And you?

training.question: What does the speaker ask?
training.feedback: And you? hỏi lại người kia.

audio.text: We went to the lake, and the weather was lovely.

training.question: What is described?
training.feedback: Lovely nghĩa là rất dễ chịu.

audio.text: Oh nice! How long did it take to get there?

training.question: What is the follow-up about?
training.feedback: How long hỏi về thời gian.

audio.text: By the way, did you try the new coffee in the kitchen?

training.question: What does the speaker do?
training.feedback: By the way chuyển chủ đề nhẹ nhàng.

audio.text: I heard it is quite good, but I have not tried it yet.

training.question: What is the speaker's experience?
training.feedback: I heard nghĩa là nghe nói.

audio.text: Anyway, let us have lunch together this week.

training.question: What is suggested?
training.feedback: Anyway báo hiệu sắp kết thúc.

audio.text: Hi, how is your week going so far?
Pretty busy, but good. I started a new project on Monday.
Oh, that sounds like a big change. Are you excited about it?

posttest.question: What does the speaker want to know?

audio.text: Anyway, I will let you get back to your work. Nice chatting!

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn âm đầu của weekend và hiking để câu trả lời nghe tự nhiên.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Nhấn sai âm tiết làm weekend và hiking khó nhận ra.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn rõ từ fun trong "That sounds like fun!" rồi xuống giọng ở cuối câu hỏi "Where did you go?".
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Giọng phẳng làm phản ứng nghe thiếu quan tâm.
